name: Victory for Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Victory for Technology Co., Ltd., which was founded on July 26, 2010, and maintains its headquarters in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, is primarily involved in the fabrication of essential semiconductor materials, electronic tapes, and electroluminescent sheets. The firm also directs its efforts towards the innovation and engineering of transparent anti-reflective (AR) films and specialized protective films designed to repel dust.
